mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) within the next 6 months, or SPX posts negative 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters with YoY GDP acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a labor market so tight that wage inflation will soon accelerate, prompting the Fed to raise rates and depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE drops below 4%, or core PCE inflation fails to exceed 3% YoY within the next 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth decelerates sharply (YoY change drops by > 2pp) while the unemployment rate is already elevated (> 6%), it signals an emerging supply-driven recession that will crush earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where the specified conditions are met, or the NBER does not declare a recession within the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow the economy and depress earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4%, or real GDP growth remains positive over the next 2 quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts above a 1.2 million annualized rate, combined with a sub-5% unemployment rate, signals overextended demand that will soon reverse and drag the economy into recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where the specified conditions are met, or the NBER does not declare a recession within the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: Steadily rising payroll employment, with a 6-month moving average above 200k jobs added per month, signals a strong labor market that will support consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where the 6-month moving average of PAYEMS exceeds 200k, or the unemployment rate rises by > 0.5pp over the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid 1% increase in the federal funds rate over 3 months, not accompanied by a rise in industrial production, signals a policy mistake that will choke off growth and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where the specified conditions are met, or real GDP growth remains positive over the next 2 quarters.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP growth accelerating by > 2% YoY, combined with a low unemployment rate below 5%, signals a demand-driven boom that will soon overheat and lead to a monetary tightening cycle, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where the specified conditions are met, or the federal funds rate does not rise by > 1% over the next 6 months.
